threadDescriptions.saturday-packing: Prepare and distribute Saturday food-bank parcels
threadDescriptions.cooler-repair: Restore reliable temperature control in the food-bank cooler
threadDescriptions.volunteer-induction: Prepare and run new volunteer induction

items.text: Saturday parcel forecast is 84 households. Pack lentils and rice at the long tables; put bread in last so it stays intact.
items.rationale: Plans the food-bank distribution batch.

items.text: Cooler log: probe reads warm after the door closes. Engineer thinks the loose door seal is the first thing to replace.
items.rationale: Records diagnosis of the faulty cooler.

items.text: Front bike lamp flickers over bumps. Clean the battery contacts before buying another unit.
items.rationale: Personal bicycle lighting repair.

items.text: New volunteer induction outline: sign in, handwashing demo, lifting technique, then confidentiality. Priya will lead the tour.
items.rationale: Defines induction content and presenter.

items.text: Parcel list update from intake: 91 households, not 84. Increase Saturday's rice and lentil bags by seven; bread supplier can cover the extra.
items.rationale: Corrects the distribution forecast and quantities.

items.text: Seal order for food-bank cooler: check hinge side before choosing the profile. Photo shows an uneven gap at the top corner.
items.rationale: Parts selection for the repair.

items.text: Priya — bring the blue sheet. I left it near the sink, I think.
items.rationale: Shared setting and contact do not identify what the sheet is for.

items.text: Induction handout has lifting photos but no large-print version. Make one for the two new volunteers who requested it.
items.rationale: Accessible preparation for the volunteer session.

items.text: Packing floor trial, Saturday: labels face out on each parcel. Keep the allergy substitutions on the short table so the two runners can check them before handover.
items.rationale: Distribution workflow and parcel handling.

items.text: Lamp contacts cleaned. Still cuts out when the front bracket shakes; the spring is cracked, not just dirty.
items.rationale: Further diagnosis of the bicycle lamp.

items.text: While the cooler is offline, Saturday parcels need shelf-stable milk instead of chilled tubs. Engineer gets the empty cooler at 07:00, packing team removes its last stock by 06:45 and updates the parcel checklist.
items.rationale: Substantive coordination of distribution substitutions and repair access.

items.text: Uh, for the new helpers, the confidentiality bit needs an example. No photos of the household register. Add that before the tour, not as an afterthought.
items.rationale: Refines an identifiable section of volunteer induction.

items.text: Engineer replaced seal and tightened hinges. Leave the cooler empty for the temperature test; record readings after repeated opening.
items.rationale: Repair completion and validation instructions.

items.text: Rice bags counted: 91. Two torn ones replaced. Saturday's substitution list is clipped to the parcel trolley.
items.rationale: Packing quantity and quality check for Saturday.

items.text: Induction attendance: nine arrived, one will catch up next week. The lifting demonstration worked better with empty crates than slides.
items.rationale: Outcome of the training session.

items.text: All stable now. Keep checking after opening.
items.rationale: Could refer to multiple objects; no identifiable temperature or equipment evidence.

items.text: Cooler stayed within its marked range during the engineer's door-opening test. File the service sheet and return stored stock after the supervisor signs off.
items.rationale: Documents repair verification.

items.text: New spring fitted to bike lamp. No flicker on the cobbled lane, and the beam stays level.
items.rationale: Confirms the lighting fix.

items.text: Saturday handover tally: 88 collected, three held for arranged pickup. Mark those three parcels with the pickup window, not household names on the outside.
items.rationale: Distribution outcome and remaining parcel handling.

items.text: Packing debrief: next time separate bread counting from the heavy bags. We crushed two loaves rushing at the end.
items.rationale: Improvement note for the completed packing operation.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: register privacy is a training-handout action here, not parcel distribution.
